name: What is the typical cost for motion sensor lighting installation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for motion sensor lighting installation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of motion sensor lighting installation in the Bay Area can vary significantly depending on several factors. These include the type and number of fixtures, whether new wiring is required, and the complexity of the installation. Basic installations might range from a few hundred dollars per fixture, while more elaborate setups with smart home integration or extensive new wiring can be considerably more. We recommend scheduling a consultation with City Dweller, LLC for a detailed and accurate estimate tailored to your specific project needs.
